scientific_integrity: Finite verification is independent enumeration of small cases, not a proof of the infinite limit; all infinite conclusions are given analytic arguments. A day-level public posting date is verified for the selected 2004 arXiv source; the older 1982 reference has no verified public day.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a first-order inversion-density law and first-order stochastic comparison, not a central limit theorem, an exact full-enumerator discovery, or an independent priority certification. Prior 1982 q-Hermite and 2014 conjugacy-class inversion polynomials determine finite distributions; potential implicit derivability of the structural theorem remains a historical risk.
title: Monotone inversion profiles and a square-root fugacity crossover for random involutions
